Etsy-API antwortet mit Fehlerstatus :sta: Etsy API responds with error status :status.

Schont das Etsy-Tageslimit (10.000 Reque: Protects the Etsy daily limit (10,000 requests); the next run catches up on the rest.
Untergrenze des Erstimports (JJJJ-MM-TT): Lower bound of the initial import (YYYY-MM-DD); empty = the last 30 days.
